value.memo:
- A（第207页）：“The burst rate will become lower during recording but pictures can continue to be taken until the card becomes full.”
- B（第298页）：“You can set a color temperature from [2500K] to [10000K].”
- C（第107、317、517页）：“Set [Touch Tab] to [ON] in [Touch Settings] in the [Custom] ([Operation]) menu.”
- C（第457页）：“There are the following restrictions when connected via HDMI and [Info Display] is set to [ON]:”  
  “[Touch Tab] is not available.”
- C（第762页）：[Custom] → [Operation] → [Touch Settings] 下的 [Touch Tab] 默认值为 [OFF]。
- D（第26页）：“You can prevent the writing and deleting of data by setting the write-protect switch (A) on the SD card to “LOCK”.”
- D（第26页）：“The data stored on a card may be damaged due to electromagnetic waves, static electricity or a failure of the camera or card.”
- D（第735页）：“Recorded data may be damaged or lost if the camera breaks down due to inappropriate handling.”
